papers_reviewed.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
papers_reviewed.method: Multi-modal DL: pre-announcement news sentiment + firm fundamentals + 30-day market dynamics → UP/DOWN/NEUTRAL prediction
papers_reviewed.notes: Most actionable PEAD upgrade found — pre-announcement window (30 days prior) adds signal distinct from EA-day 8-K

papers_reviewed.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers_reviewed.method: BERT-based structured extraction of press release sections (headline, guidance, body) — 138k documents 2005-2023
papers_reviewed.notes: Soft information (text structure) as informative as EPS hard data; structured parsing more discriminative than FinBERT bag-of-words

papers_reviewed.title: Beyond Prompting: An Autonomous Framework for Systematic Factor Investing via Agentic AI
papers_reviewed.method: 3-agent loop (formulator → evaluator → memory) with regime-adaptive memory update; self-directed, no manual prompts
papers_reviewed.notes: Memory-update mechanism addresses momentum crash regime — adapts signals dynamically. Extends H352/H349 into production-viable continuous loop

papers_reviewed.title: LLM as a Risk Manager: LLM Semantic Filtering for Lead-Lag Trading in Prediction Markets
papers_reviewed.method: Two-stage: Granger causality candidate selection + LLM semantic plausibility filter for lead-lag pairs
papers_reviewed.notes: Applied to prediction market pairs; relevant to Kalshi cross-event arbitrage pipeline. Low-cost implementation.

papers_reviewed.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization with Bias Correction
papers_reviewed.method: EWMA rounding error correction for cross-sectional ranking; IC degradation fix (0.005 IC preserved per bias correction)
papers_reviewed.notes: Implementation detail improvement (bias correction) rather than new alpha. Relevant for H217/H228 if IC degradation suspected.

papers_reviewed.title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets
papers_reviewed.method: Survey/framework paper; semantic memory for regime detection, drift handling in episode retrieval
papers_reviewed.notes: Survey rather than testable system; adds to multi-agent-llm-trading.md wiki context

papers_reviewed.title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Markets with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers_reviewed.method: RL-based dynamic pair selection for crypto; 1-hour interval data
papers_reviewed.notes: Crypto-specific; pairs family closed for equity per H307/H246 results
